observations.reason: Exact public data classes and fixed @Composable API are in required package. Imports are existing Compose/Material3 only, no observer/test package or additional dependency. Public source-bound native renders support compilation; no whole-repository delta claim.

remember holds internal MenuReviewDraft; initial fields and different-ID reset match requirements; equal revision returns same draft. Reconciliation runs before rendering and persists in same remember slot.
Caller options.forEach preserves order; ID/availability/sent/same-ID guards protect selection, then count clamps and acceptance clears.
Minus/plus guard available selection, sent and inclusive bound then decrement/increment exactly one, clearing acceptance; selection and reconciliation coerce current count into new bounds.

Integer current price/count, current prepaid and current credit determine signed Int balance. toLong absolute magnitude formatter uses ASCII dollar/period/two decimals; zero/refund/payment branches follow required copy.
Initial false, independently enabled for positive new credit and unsent; setter guards these conditions and clears acceptance; reconciliation forces false for zero new credit.
All relevant edits and revisions clear acceptance. Acceptance requires valid selected option before send; canSend also requires acceptance and unsent.

Production reconciliation handles ID reset and same-ID changed revisions before UI. All render derivations use current model; removed/unavailable selection clears, desired count remains until clamp, withdrawn credit clears, accepted/sent reset, no keyed component recreation.

The only onSubmit invocation is valid send Button action, constructing all six current fields and synchronously emitting before sent=true. Edit/reconciliation callbacks remain silent, and sent guards prevent repeat send.

Native FontFamily.Default TextStyle uses required sp bases and weights throughout: 12 medium,28 bold,13 normal,18 semibold,15 normal/option semibold,26 bold,16 semibold,20 semibold. No density/font-scale cap. These are source declarations, not OS computed-style claims.

Non-scrolling Column owns 16dp padding,20dp sections,20dp root radius; card helper 16dp radius/12dp padding/1dp border; 8dp inner and option gaps,10dp notes,16dp footer. No maxLines, ellipsis, text fixed height or horizontal scrolling; weighted count keeps controls in one Row.

Native Button modifier/padding specify 64dp choice minHeight,44dp quantity minimum width/height,52dp send minHeight,16dp horizontal/14dp vertical send padding; text can grow. Native box result remains a separate atom.

Every exact light/dark palette constant is selected by current MaterialTheme luminance. Canvas, solid summary, notice, selected option border/fill, signed refund ink, native send enabled/disabled fills and unavailable secondary text are explicitly wired; no complete-row opacity modifier.
Native Alignment.Start/TextAlign.Start/Row and caller iteration are used, with no forced direction or array reversal. Quantity, currency and receipt interpolation preserve required ASCII format.

API tags are on actual native Button/Switch/Text or containing summary/canvas; no merged parent leaf for canvas/summary. Option native semantic contentDescription is exact title plus selected state; supporting visual descendants are cleared, with one clickable Button. Switch has only its native target. No hidden duplicate or style readback.
Current fixture fields, options and notes are decoded without derivation, and only typed production submission.wireValue is forwarded.
Imports production types and directly invokes MenuChangeReviewPanel at stable @Composable call site, no clone, keyed recreation or local product state.

scope: Bound actual source review; not computed runtime style or executed integration proof.
